meta.name: game-developer
meta.description: Use when building game systems, implementing Unity/Unreal Engine features, or optimizing game performance. Invoke to implement ECS architecture, configure physics systems and colliders, set up multiplayer networking with lag compensation, optimize frame rates to 60+ FPS targets, develop shaders, or apply game design patterns such as object pooling and state machines. Trigger keywords: Unity, Unreal Engine, game development, ECS architecture, game physics, multiplayer networking, game optimization, shader programming, game AI.

copy.tagline: 构建游戏系统、优化帧率与网络同步
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Unity 或 Unreal 开发游戏，需要优化性能或实现复杂系统
copy.tagline_en: Build game systems, optimize frame rate and network sync
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing games with Unity or Unreal and need to optimize performance or implement complex systems

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计游戏架构、编写 Unity 或 Unreal Engine 的代码，并优化性能（如保持 60 FPS）。它会使用对象池、状态机等模式，并避免常见性能陷阱。
howto.when: 当你提到 Unity、Unreal Engine、游戏开发、ECS 架构、游戏物理、多人网络、游戏优化、着色器编程或游戏 AI 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Unity 写一个对象池，用于子弹的频繁生成和回收。
say.note: Claude 会生成 ObjectPool 类代码。

say.text: 在 Unreal Engine 中如何实现一个简单的状态机？
say.note: Claude 会提供状态机设计模式和代码示例。

say.text: 优化我的游戏，使其在移动设备上达到 60 FPS。
say.note: Claude 会给出性能分析和优化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design game architecture, write Unity or Unreal Engine code, and optimize performance (e.g., maintain 60 FPS). It uses patterns like object pooling and state machines, and avoids common performance pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords such as Unity, Unreal Engine, game development, ECS architecture, game physics, multiplayer networking, game optimization, shader programming, or game AI.

say_en.text: Write an object pool in Unity for frequent bullet spawning and recycling.
How to implement a simple state machine in Unreal Engine?
say_en.note: Claude provides state machine design pattern and code example.

say_en.text: Optimize my game to achieve 60 FPS on mobile devices.
say_en.note: Claude gives performance analysis and optimization suggestions.
